name: Autocam Medical
old_description: A global contract manufacturer of orthopedic implants, spinal implants, precision instruments and orthopedic cutting tools.
about:
Autocam Medical is a privately held contract manufacturer headquartered in Warsaw, Indiana. The company operates globally with a 100,000-square-foot global headquarters and manufacturing facility in Kentwood, Michigan, plus additional operations in Plymouth, Massachusetts; Murfreesboro, Tennessee; and Suzhou, China.

The company specializes in precision-machined components for orthopedic and spinal procedures, producing surgical drill bits, drivers, screws, plates, cutting tools, implants, instruments, handpieces, and other device components. Its core processes include CNC milling, CNC turning, and cutter grinding, supported by design-for-manufacturing engineering. The new $60 million Kentwood facility is expected to create 250 jobs and expands the company’s manufacturing footprint in West Michigan.

Autocam Medical serves medical device manufacturers whose products are used in spine, foot and ankle, hand and wrist, hip and knee, shoulder and elbow, and craniomaxillofacial procedures. Its customers are typically original equipment manufacturers in the orthopedic and surgical instrument markets.

The company emphasizes a value-added approach to high-precision manufacturing, leveraging proprietary processes and state-of-the-art equipment built to its own specifications. Design-for-manufacturing engineering is integrated early to add value across the entire production cycle.
